messages:
alice (oncall): noticing big latency tail on production inference, starting ~2111112200, looks correlated with KV cache growth
carla (mlrt): metrics show KV cache items spiking concurrently with continuous-batcher queue length rising, eviction rate can't keep up
david (sre): graph: eviction_count/sec -> flat, cache_size_bytes -> up 3x, p50 latency -> steady, p99 -> up 2.5x
eve (support): receiving customer complaints about slow completions and 504s, customer: org-6421, sampling requests show repeated long prefixes
IncidentBot: incident created: KV-cache + continuous-batch surge detected (severity: high)
bob (infra): on it, checking scheduler config, any recent deploys to batcher?
carla (mlrt): we rolled a config change to continuous-batcher 6 hours ago to increase max_num_seqs from 128 -> 2048 for a throughput experiment (didnt fully validate memory growth)
alice (oncall): that is likely it. 2048 is huge. should be 128 normally.
david (sre): confirm in config store: /configs/serving/continuous-batcher -> {"max_num_seqs": 2048, "max_batch_tokens": 65536, "idle_timeout_ms": 1200}
bob (infra): scheduler is grouping very large KV caches per sequence now, eviction can't reclaim fast enough. we need a quick mitigation: rollback max_num_seqs to 128 and lower max_batch_tokens to 8192
eve (support): timeframe for rollback? customers currently seeing ~6-12s extra latency on p95, some timeouts
carla (mlrt): agree with rollback. also temporarily increase eviction workers to 3x and reduce idle_timeout_ms to 400 to force earlier flush
bob (infra): preparing hotfix patch. will patch config in control-plane and trigger rolling restart of batcher pods canary first
deploy-bot: will deploy config change to cluster batcher-group-canary in 30s if approved
alice (oncall): approve deploy-canary :thumbsup:
david (sre): applying patch: 
```
curl -X PATCH https://controlplane.internal/configs/serving/continuous-batcher \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer ***' \
  -d '{"max_num_seqs":128,"max_batch_tokens":8192,"idle_timeout_ms":400}'
```
bob (infra): canary went to 2 pods, observing metrics...
carla (mlrt): cache_size_bytes on canary decreased within 20s, eviction_count up as expected, latency p99 on canary dropped ~1.8s
david (sre): promoting to remainder of batchers now, will stagger restarts over 2m windows to avoid steady-state disruption
eve (support): telling affected customers we have mitigation in progress, ETA 10m for full roll/validation
IncidentBot: escalation note: oncall handoff to david at 2111112300
alice (oncall): handing to david, I have notes on config and queries observed in the first 20m
david (sre): continuing, full roll complete at 2111112338, monitoring
bob (infra): also increased eviction worker count param to 3 and tightened cache-ttl for prefix entries to 60s temporarily
carla (mlrt): quick post-mortem note: the experimental change to max_num_seqs had no workload gating and allowed pathological noisy prefixes to cause retention blowups. need an approval + perf test for >512 changes
david (sre): customer impact summary: about 37 orgs experienced elevated latency; 6 had transient 504s during the peak window (2111112200-2111112330). No data loss.
eve (support): sent templated update to affected customers: "We're rolling a fix now, expect restored latency within 10 minutes. Root cause: batcher config regression."
carla (mlrt): followups: add config validation in control-plane (reject max_num_seqs > 512 in prod by default), add telemetry alert for cache growth correlating with max_num_seqs changes
bob (infra): will open PR with guardrails + add a canary job that runs a mem-pressure scenario before allowlisting big batch settings
alice (oncall): good. create incident ticket with timeline and assign owners for each follow-up
david (sre): done https://internal.issues/RED-INC-2210 (link) — owners: carla (root cause + tests), bob (guardrails + infra), alice (customer comms)
IncidentBot: incident annotated: severity->resolved when sustained p99 < 2s for 10m
david (sre): p99 stabilized under threshold at 2111112375, closing incident in 5m after observation window
eve (support): final customer update prepared, will send after closure :white_check_mark:
carla (mlrt): adding unit + e2e tests to ensure continuous-batcher memory usage doesn't regress with large seq batch sizes
alice (oncall): thanks team. lesson: perf experiments must be gated and tested, and config store needs sanity checks. :beer:
